text.text_excerpt: We didn't learn about Vieux Carre' until our last night in New Orleans - big mistake, because we had been dropping money for mediocre bottles of wine from Walgreens and CVS for premium costs. We picked up a bottle of rosé and picked up some complimentary plastic cups for them. The prices are reasonable and the selection is aplenty. There's also a nice liquor selection, although we had just come in looking for wine. It was tempting. A lot of reviews reference making your own drinks here. This didn't happen for us - but I wouldn't be surprised to hear that it existed. I'll have to take a closer look when I'm back. Next time I'm in town in the French Quarter (next week...), I'll be sure to s...

Liquor stores are a dime a dozen in New Orleans, but the centrality of this one in the quarter and it's nice atmosphere always seem to draw me back. It's a very convenient store because most of the time I just want to get a drink and walk around without being really tied to any bar or anything. Getting drinks from bars in the quarter can get really expensive. Here, you can find all the normal things you could want at a good price. Go for the things on SALE. $3 bottles of Blue Nun, why not! Me and my girl each picked up these huge bottles of Blue Moon's limited edition "Grand Cru," each one being like 25 or so ounces and 8.5% alcohol for $5.00 each (down from $9.00 because the sell-by-date...

This is a French quarter gem. Although it appears to be a tiny place from the outside, once you actually walk in you'll realize there is much more stock than you've ever imagined. Wine is the focus, however they carry a full line of liquor, beer, soda, mixers and even some lovely snacks. They feature an excellent selection of champagne and if you don't see something- just ask- they are likely to have it! On the chance that they don't have something they are happy to bring it in for you. Given that it is located in the French Quarter you would expect to pay outrageous prices...right?
